name: Missing link line break
idea: After a rising trend ends in a fault, double, trap or climax and the first leg away goes beyond the last pullback, a signal on the first close over the line from that extreme resting on the later swings. The mirror after a falling trend. Wrong beyond the extreme since the anchor.

params.label: Swing size (the swing degree read)
params.help: Which swings are read: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history. Reference: 0.

params.label: Bars for the average true range the tolerances are measured in
params.help: Bars for the average true range the tolerances are measured in. Reference: 14.

params.label: Equal-extreme tolerance, in average true ranges
params.help: Two swing extremes within this many average true ranges are equal (a double). Reference: 0.1.

params.label: Trap: furthest overshoot, as a share of its own leg
params.help: A trap goes beyond the swing before by at most this share of its own leg. Reference: 0.2.

params.label: Trap: bars after the extreme for the close back inside
params.help: A trap's close back inside must come within this many bars of its extreme. Reference: 5.

params.label: Climax: share of the leg given back
params.help: A climax gives back at least this share of the leg that made the extreme. Reference: 1.

params.label: Climax: the give-back within this many times the leg's bars
params.help: A climax's give-back comes within this many times the bars of that leg. Reference: 1.5.

params.label: Missing link: rising highs (falling lows) in the trend before
params.help: The trend before the missing link: at least this many rising highs with higher lows (or the mirror). Reference: 3.

params.label: Missing link: touches of the line, its anchor included
params.help: The missing link's line: at least this many touches, its anchor included. Reference: 3.

params.label: Line touch tolerance, in average true ranges
params.help: A swing within this many average true ranges of the line touches it. Reference: 0.25.

setup.long: PricePattern("missing_link", "up", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, eq_tol=$eq_tol, trap_max=$trap_max, trap_bars=$trap_bars, climax_r=$climax_r, climax_speed=$climax_speed, impulses=$impulses, touches=$touches, touch_tol=$touch_tol)
setup.short: PricePattern("missing_link", "down", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, eq_tol=$eq_tol, trap_max=$trap_max, trap_bars=$trap_bars, climax_r=$climax_r, climax_speed=$climax_speed, impulses=$impulses, touches=$touches, touch_tol=$touch_tol)

invalidation.long: PricePatternLevel("missing_link_void", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, eq_tol=$eq_tol, trap_max=$trap_max, trap_bars=$trap_bars, climax_r=$climax_r, climax_speed=$climax_speed, impulses=$impulses, touches=$touches, touch_tol=$touch_tol)
invalidation.short: PricePatternLevel("missing_link_void", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, eq_tol=$eq_tol, trap_max=$trap_max, trap_bars=$trap_bars, climax_r=$climax_r, climax_speed=$climax_speed, impulses=$impulses, touches=$touches, touch_tol=$touch_tol)
